# Sources

The license and notices for each source is included in the source's corresponding subfolder.

## AWS SDK for .NET

Pulled from [GitHub](https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-net).

### Modifications

- Only used select Extensions from the original SDK to minimize build sizes
- Imported files into Unity which adds corresponding `.meta` files
- Compiled the necessary DLLs for binding to in Unity
